full_prompt_en: A square landscape oil painting follows a stony pale lane as it climbs between low village buildings. The path begins broad across the lower edge, bends left around a grassy rise and narrows into the middle distance. A rough white plaster wall dominates the right foreground, its surface broken by blue gray and warm ochre marks. Behind it stands a modest cottage with a blue-lavender upper facade, dark roof and small chimney. A narrow dark doorway opens where the building meets the path. At the left, a sloping bank of saturated teal and green grass rises to a low gray stone wall. Beyond the bend, more pale houses and rust-brown roofs cluster under a light blue sky. No people appear; the lane and walls carry the visual movement. Short, thick brush touches describe uneven stones in the path and patches of vegetation along both edges. Cool turquoise, cobalt and violet shadows animate the white surfaces, while orange and ochre flecks warm the ground. The small rooftops and distant building are more compressed and less distinct than the foreground wall and path. Daylight is soft and open, with pale sky illuminating the plaster but leaving blue shadows beneath rooflines and in the recessed doorway. Contours are built from adjacent strokes rather than uniform drawn lines, and the pigment retains a grainy, worked texture. The composition draws the eye forward along the light pathway, then turns it around the left bend toward the tucked-away buildings. The overall view feels intimate and briskly painted, joining a simple village route to a dense mosaic of cool greens and warm stone colors.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形风景油画沿着一条浅色石路，穿过低矮村舍向上走。路从下缘宽阔起步，绕过草坡向左弯，在中景渐渐收窄。右前方一面粗糙白灰墙占据显著面积，表面被蓝灰和暖赭笔痕打破。墙后是一座朴素村舍，蓝紫色上层墙面、深屋顶和小烟囱可见。房屋与小路相接处开着一道窄暗门。左边，饱和青绿草坡升向低矮灰石墙。越过弯道，更多浅色房屋和锈褐屋顶聚在淡蓝天空下。画中无人；道路和墙体承担视觉流动。短而厚的笔触描述路上参差石块及两侧植被斑块。冷青绿、钴蓝和紫色阴影让白墙活跃起来，橙与赭色碎点温暖地面。小屋顶和远处房屋比前景墙与路更压缩、更模糊。日光柔和而开阔，浅色天空照亮灰墙，却在屋檐下和深门洞里留下蓝色阴影。轮廓由相邻笔触叠成，而非整齐描线，颜料保有颗粒和反复加工的肌理。构图让视线沿浅色小路向前，再绕左弯转到藏在后方的房舍。整体景象亲切、落笔敏捷，把简单的乡村道路连到冷绿和暖石色构成的密集马赛克之中。
style_prompt_en: The image has a tactile oil-painted surface built from short, firm strokes and small broken flecks of color. Pale cream and chalky white masses meet saturated teal, deep green and blue-violet shadows, with ochre and rust accents scattered through them. Light areas are not smooth; cool marks remain visible inside them and make the surface vibrate. Edges are assembled from adjoining strokes, sometimes crisp at major boundaries and sometimes lost where similar colors mingle. An open daylight atmosphere provides gentle, broad illumination, while recesses carry concentrated cool darks. The perspective is compact and slightly elevated, with a light curving route drawing the eye from a wide foreground into a tighter middle distance. Nearby texture is dense and distinct, while far forms become smaller and more compressed. The color rhythm alternates pale upright masses with sloping green and blue fields. The whole arrangement feels immediate and hand-worked, balancing a clear spatial path against an energetic mosaic of pigment.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有可触的油画表面，由短而有力的笔触和细碎断色搭成。浅奶油色与粉白团块遇上饱和青绿、深绿和蓝紫阴影，其间散落赭色与锈色强调。亮区并不平滑，冷色笔痕仍清楚留在其中，使表面振动。边缘由相邻笔触拼接，有时在主要界线上清楚，有时在相近颜色交融处消失。开阔日光提供轻柔、宽泛的照明，凹处则聚集浓冷暗色。透视紧凑且略高，一条浅色弯曲路径引导视线从宽前景走向更窄的中景。近处肌理密集明确，远处形体更小、更压缩。色彩节奏在浅色竖向团块和倾斜绿蓝色域之间交替。整体布局直接而有手工痕迹，在清楚的空间路线与活跃的颜料马赛克之间取得平衡。
theme_en: A rough pale lane curves uphill between white cottages and green banks
theme_zh: 一条粗糙浅色小路在白色村舍与绿色坡岸之间弯曲上行
name: Ernest Lawson
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
